Taking advantage of AirTag 2 falling to a historical low again, the brand-new M5 Pro MacBook Pro model saves US$400 today, iPhone Air also has a US$170 discount (or you can choose an open-box model, saving up to US$406), and there are also many offers covering various official Apple accessories.
